notes: ClaugE ablations (run_ablations.py), on Camelyon17 and RxRx1. A variant that retrains its members uses the main pools' seeds (pool seed 1000 k + c), so its member j has the same training settings and seeds as ClaugE's member j and differs only in what the variant changes. candidates: candidates per path of the retrained variants; with fewer than 5 the reference is ClaugE restricted to the same first candidates of its own pools (and only k_max = 5 is built). ssl_weights: the DINO ResNet-50 backbone state dict (dino_resnet50_pretrain.pth), downloaded separately. Paths are relative to methods/ClaugE.
